frontmatter.description: Triggered when the user asks to write WordPress articles compatible with Rank Math SEO. Produces Gutenberg block-paste-ready HTML with HowTo/FAQ blocks, FK density 1.0-1.5%, 12 H2 structure.

loaderBehaviour: Windsurf was renamed Devin Desktop by Cognition in June 2026. It reads .devin/rules/*.md as Cascade Rules; the legacy .windsurf/rules/ folder is still honoured as a fallback. Project scope only — there is no user-global rules folder. References must be embedded inline; the installer concatenates the most-needed reference files into the rule body.
verificationNote: Verified against Devin Desktop as of July 2026. The platform key stays `windsurf` for CLI compatibility. On a pre-rename Windsurf build, install to the legacy path instead: run with --to .windsurf (writes .windsurf/rules/rankmath-seo-wp.md).
